flagged.comment: Affidavit of No Liens required for all sites has not been located in the supplementary documents provided with the site plan application. The checklist notes that the code citation is under review and may be a DSD administrative intake requirement.

Affidavit of No Liens has not been provided. This is a required document for all site plan applications as an administrative intake requirement, separate from LDC 25-1-81 which governs who may file an application. The affidavit must be provided for the application to be complete.
An Affidavit of No Liens has not been located in the supplementary documents submitted with the consolidated site plan application.

Water Benchmarking Application has been submitted but contains unresolved deficiencies. OWB review comments (OWB2, OWB7, OWB8, OWB9) show pending status with corrections required to GFA consistency and irrigated landscape area values. Director approval of the Water Benchmarking Application is a mandatory pre-release condition per LDC 25-9-413(A); application must be corrected and approved before site plan release.

Water Benchmarking Application is not documented in supplementary documents. OWB review comments reference a benchmarking application requiring updates, but no evidence of Austin Water director approval prior to site plan release has been provided. For 39-unit multi-family projects receiving Austin Water retail service, the Water Benchmarking Application must be submitted and approved by the director before release per LDC § 25-9-413(A); there is no exemption for revisions.
areas: Pre-release condition for site plan approval

flagged.comment: Placeholder text remains in a document number field on Sheet 1, Block 12. The Integrated Pest Management Plan reference states 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________' with the document number field left blank. Replace placeholder with actual recorded document number or remove the reference if not applicable.

Placeholder text in recording document number field has not been replaced. Sheet 1, Block 12 states: 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________, Official Public Records, Travis County, Texas.' The document number field is blank and must be filled with the actual recorded document number.

No documentation of 911 Addressing verification or address confirmation is present in the application package. While an Addressing Plan (Sheet 29) is included in the plan set, there is no verification letter from 911 Addressing or Austin Development Services Addressing Review confirming that the address '3759 Valley View Road, Austin, TX 78704' has been verified prior to final approval.

A current Surveyor's Certificate required per LDC § 25-1-82 for application completeness has not been located in supplementary documents. While Sheet 2 contains the historical 1975 surveyor certification for the Mecey Subdivision plat, a current surveyor's certificate for the Valley View Townhomes site plan (SP-2025-0126C) is not documented.

Plan set does not include the required plan modification threshold note stating that modifications moving a structure more than 25 feet or increasing height or square footage will require Planning Commission and/or City Council review. This standard plan note must be added to the plan notes block on all sites requiring this notation per LDC Chapter 25-5.

Tenant notification note regarding building demolition is not present in plan notes. The site plan shows demolition of an existing structure (former assisted living facility). Per LDC § 25-1-712 and BCM 16.2, when occupied structures are proposed for demolition and the project involves 5 or more residential units (this project has 39 units), a plan note is required specifying that building demolition is subject to tenant notification regulations requiring a 120-day notification period before the building or demolition permit is approved.

Plans do not include an explicit use notation in the plan notes block. While the proposed use (multi-family townhomes) is referenced indirectly in other notes (commercial and multi-family recycling ordinance compliance, parkland dedication for 39 residential units), there is no standalone note explicitly stating the proposed use. Whether this level of implicit use identification satisfies the requirement, or whether an explicit 'Use: Multi-Family Townhomes' notation is required, cannot be determined from available documents.

Asbestos pipe note is present on Sheet 18 but does not comply with General Site Plan Notes Note #25 requirements. The existing note requires work plan review and coordination with City Building Services Department but does not explicitly require the mandatory 30-day advance contact with City of Austin Asbestos Manager before disturbance. The note must be updated to include the 30-day advance notice requirement as specified in the General Site Plan Notes Note #25.
